category_title: Active and physically competent children with speech and developmental delays
student_description: Jamie is a highly active, physically competent, and determined child who excels in self-directed physical play. However, his spontaneity and independence immediately vanish when adults provide overly directive, hand-over-hand assistance. He uniquely requires adults to interact with him as peers, using running commentary and playful participation to encourage his verbalization while allowing him to maintain physical control of the activity.

criteria.rationale: Understanding Jamie's true capabilities requires seeing him in environments where he naturally excels and communicates best.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must include systematically observing Jamie (live or via video) in his optimal, highly physical communication environments.

criteria.rationale: Because Jamie's competence and independence can be easily hindered by adult over-direction, staff and parents must collaborate to identify and remove these barriers.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must involve discussing Jamie's competences with his parents or engaging in critical reflection with staff regarding environmental barriers to his independence.
